{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABUaPrmQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzg975Es", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 17, "title": "Publish and validate the Web playground on GitHub Pages", "body": "## Problem

The Pages infrastructure and static placeholder for #15 are proposed in #16, but the workflow has not reached `main`. Checks on 2026-10-02 confirmed that Pages uses GitHub Actions with HTTPS enforced, there are no Actions runs on `main`, and https://takahirox.github.io/my-audio-to-text/ returns HTTP 404.

This issue explicitly takes the remaining publication and live acceptance scope from #15. The infrastructure PR can be reviewed separately; local rendering and mobile viewport emulation do not complete these live checks.

## Expected outcome

Publish the minimal Web playground and verify access from desktop and mobile browsers, including an update after a subsequent deployment.

## Scope and dependency

After #16 is reviewed and merged into `main`, inspect the Pages deployment and fix any deployment failures. If necessary, manually dispatch the existing workflow with `main` selected. Keep the implementation limited to plain static HTML and Pages infrastructure.

Do not introduce a framework, microphone capture, an ASR backend, personalization, PWA support, or application UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The Pages workflow succeeds on `main`. Record the run URL and deployed commit SHA.
- [ ] The canonical public Pages URL returns HTTP 200 over HTTPS. Record the URL and check time.
- [ ] The published placeholder renders in a desktop browser. Record the browser and result.
- [ ] The same published URL opens and renders in an actual mobile browser. Record the device, browser, and result; viewport emulation alone is insufficient.
- [ ] A subsequent small placeholder change is reviewed and merged into `main`; the automatic redeployment succeeds and the changed content appears at the same URL. Record the subsequent commit, run URL, changed text, and browser result.

## Definition of done

All five live checks above have recorded evidence. The README links the actual published URL and reflects the validation results. Until then, publication and automatic redeployment remain unverified.

## Related issues

Remaining live publication and validation scope split from #15; depends on the infrastructure proposed in #16.
